components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Any non-digit characters are
            stripped on create; exactly 10 digits must remain.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-01'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099);
            a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the
            derived 'ageBand'. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permit creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners that were created into the same
                household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: 8d1f7c3e-2a4b-3c5d-9e6f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared its first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation:
                starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount
                is 0, capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today at
                the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: PHONE
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners are
                duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## What I changed

The request now accepts an optional `birthDate`, and `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns a derived `ageBand` (`MINOR` <18, `ADULT` 18–64, `SENIOR` 65+) computed against `registrationDate`.

To keep structural impact low, I added behaviour as small, self-contained units rather than growing any existing method:

1. **`util/AgeBands.java`** (new) — one tiny static `of(birthDate, asOf)` classifier, zero surrounding complexity.
2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a `birthDate` field with plain getter/setter plus a `@Transient getAgeBand()` that just delegates to `AgeBands`. Because the getter name matches the DTO property, MapStruct auto-maps it — so I did **not** touch the `OwnerMapper` expressions or any existing complex method.
3. **`openapi.yml`** — `birthDate` on `OwnerFields` (input) and read-only `ageBand` on `Owner` (output).
4. **Schema/seed SQL** — added `birth_date DATE` to all four `schema.sql` files, and fixed the one positional seed file (`db/hsqldb/data.sql`) that the tests actually load. The h2/postgres seeds use named-column inserts, so they needed no change.

I deliberately avoided editing the large `OwnerRestControllerV1` and the `OwnerMapper` mapping block; the only Java functions I touched are the three trivial (CC=1) accessors on `Owner` and the new util method.

One note worth flagging: `db/mysql/data.sql` already had positional owner inserts inconsistent with its own schema (7 values against a wider table) before this change — a pre-existing issue unrelated to the age-band work, and it isn't exercised by the test profile (`hsqldb`).
